meta.frame: body (x fwd, y left, z up), origin CAD origin, m; pitch > 0 nose down, roll > 0 right low
meta.units: SI unless a key says kN / MPa / deg

limit_criteria.A: rod yield SF >= 1.5 at the levelling-end / dynamic-max lateral force with the static axial force
limit_criteria.A_Pdyn141: as A with axial max(141 kN, static) on every leg (sensitivity)
limit_criteria.L: the same lateral force sustained with the 350 bar lock axial 364 kN: SF >= 1.0 (no yield)
limit_criteria.RA_A: with re-anchoring (3.10.7): peak = levelling end x manoeuvre factor at the run max axial, SF >= 1.5; residual after re-anchoring: SF >= 1.5 static and >= 1.0 at 364 kN
limit_criteria.RA_B: option (design-criterion decision): as RA_A but the one-off peak only SF >= 1.0
limit_criteria.guide: piston guide pressure (20 mm CAD width, centre model) <= 40 / 100 MPa (information only)
limit_criteria.by: criterion = first failing angle; stroke = a leg reaches the 680 mm stroke first; angles beyond the simulated vertices are extrapolated with the scaled kinematics

assumptions.lateral_force_source: dynamics_model.md rev.18 3.10 matrix (pad_tangential_check.json), mu 0.5, secant k_t = best estimate, YAML k_t = upper bound; between / beyond the simulated angles: anchored-pad kinematics scaled per leg to the provisional-boundary vertex
